feeds.title: theweeklysoccerreferee
feeds.description: The Weekly Soccer Referee Blog is produced by George Wilhelmsen. He has worked a variety of games, from rec to competitive to the adult amateur league, to adult recreational league games to tournaments, and has been writing this blog for 15 years so that all may learn from the wacky things that happen on the pitch.
